speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The owl is in my hand since Friday. We will say the end of it, and we will not improve it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One stop, moved, so the line need not be spent to reach its end. No word of it changed.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Shall I stand to it, Master Phillips?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Walk it if thou must move, Nick. Standing still is how a boy shows he can, and showing is not singing. Thou hast the Princess. Today thou wilt not take the song from the man who has it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast the Princess. Thursday, her first long speech, and not this morning. Augustine, do not make the song a test.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will not sing. I will tell you whether a yard could hear the end of it. That is my whole use before dinner.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then hear the stop, Tom, and tell me if the breath arrives with the word or after it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The stop holds. I heard the end. I did not hear a man drowning to get there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it stays. I will not move it again because a room was kind.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And the Princess, this week?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Thursday, in the cold parlour, and not as a song. Thou wilt walk her first long speech. Today thou wilt eat. John wants thee in Cheapside before noon, to be measured.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Today, after this, is Fair Em. I am in it. The new comedy is not in front of a yard. The parts are out. The day we set is the day.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Which is not tomorrow, and not the day after. I am glad. I have a back, and Fair Em has a fight in it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Two songs, Will. The cuckoo and the owl. Both in my book. You will not send me a third before Lent.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. You have the songs. I have the comedy. That is the division, and I mean to keep it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Is the King to be new-clothed, when it comes?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not from me, and not this morning. He can wear what he wore.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: What he wore will play on Saturday, if the seams hold. I am for that.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam copies stops when there are stops to copy. He copies with his feet. We will give him a short room on Thursday, not this morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not this morning. I was at Field's door and I did not come away with a book.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Good. A book is a rehearsal that will not stand in a yard. What did the printer say?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That a book cannot walk home. I will ask him again in Lent. Not before.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I will learn the speech I have, and not a chronicle.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Learn it walking, on Thursday. And eat before the afternoon. A boy who sings on an empty belly spends the note twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The owl can rest. I am for the afternoon when they call it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then rest it. I will go and see whether the red cuff was turned, or only promised.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Go and eat, Nick. John will not measure a boy who has missed his bread.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am going, Master Phillips.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday for the speech. Not a word of it this morning.
